title: The pinned Agent set only ca, so NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 turned verification off and a foreign server serving the public CA could get the token
resolution: The pinned Agent sets rejectUnauthorized true; tests under the variable refuse a foreign control plane and a foreign broker, whose client already pins it.

title: fetch followed redirects, so a 307 or 308 to http: carried the token without TLS and the client accepted the plain answer
resolution: Every request carries redirect error through the HttpFetch port, the CA read included; tests for 307 and 308 show the plain target gets nothing.

title: The guide's bootstrap step still copied the CA into the removed worker trust volume
resolution: The step names only the broker files; the worker gets the fingerprint through the enrollment bundle.
